profile.summary: Overaa Construction is a family-owned general contractor based in Richmond, California. It does preconstruction planning, general contracting and collaborative project delivery, and builds its own work with its own crews. It builds schools, labs, water and energy facilities, health care, housing and other projects in Northern California.
